**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 13 already satisfies the preferred position on all four parameters:

- **Affiliates/contractors:** §13.1 grants the subscription right directly to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf," plus Authorized Users — no notice condition needed (better than our fallback).
- **Paid-up licences perpetual/irrevocable:** §13.2 gives Customer and its Affiliates a "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence," including modification/derivative-work and contractor-support rights; §14.3 extends it to Vendor Technology required to use a Deliverable, and §10.1 preserves it post-termination.
- **No revocation at will:** §13.3 bars revocation or suspension except for a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity (consistent with §9.1).
- **Transferability:** §13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor under §24, and §24.1 allows consent-free assignment in an M&A or asset transaction.

The §13.4 restrictions are not overbroad — they are limited to knowing reverse engineering (with a statutory carve-out), interference, security-control bypass, and unlawful use, and expressly do not limit authorized security testing or use of Customer Data and output.
